record.paper_title: Some open problems on excluding a uniform matroid
record.context_brief: Incompatible bicircular and dual cycle grid minors
record.original_question: For every positive integer k, does there exist an integer n such that any matroid M with two n-interconnected minors B(G_n^+) and M(G_n^+)^* must contain a U_{k,2k}-minor? Here G_n^+ is the graph obtained by adding an apex vertex to an n by n grid, B(G) is the bicircular matroid of G, and M(G) is the cycle matroid of G.

evidence.quote: The bicircular matroid of G, denoted B(G), is defined as B+(G) \ V.
The graph G+ n is constructed by adding an apex vertex to an n × n grid.
Conjecture 9.3. For any positive integer k, there is an integer n such that, if M is a matroid with two n-interconnected minors B(G+ n ) and M(G+n )∗, then M contains a Uk,2k-minor.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $G_n^+$ denote the graph obtained from the $n \times n$ grid by adding an apex vertex adjacent to every grid vertex. For a graph $G$, let $M(G)$ denote its cycle (graphic) matroid, and let $B(G)$ denote its bicircular matroid: the matroid on the edge set $E(G)$ whose independent sets are exactly the edge sets of subgraphs in which every connected component contains at most one cycle. For a matroid $N$, write $N^*$ for the dual of $N$.

Two minors $N_1$ and $N_2$ of a matroid $M$ are said to be $n$-interconnected if, for every partition $(X, Y)$ of $E(M)$ with $|X|, |Y| \ge n$, the matroid $M$ is not the direct sum of a minor extension of $N_1$ on one side and a minor extension of $N_2$ on the other; more precisely, neither side of the partition can be contracted/deleted away to leave the other minor intact, witnessing high connectivity between the two minors in $M$.

Let $U_{k,2k}$ denote the uniform matroid of rank $k$ on $2k$ elements.

Prove or disprove: for every positive integer $k$, there exists a positive integer $n = n(k)$ such that every matroid $M$ which contains both $B(G_n^+)$ and $M(G_n^+)^*$ as $n$-interconnected minors must contain $U_{k,2k}$ as a minor.
artifact.status_search_result: The statement is posed as a conjecture in the context of excluded-minor problems for uniform matroids. A search for follow-up work on this specific conjecture about $n$-interconnected $B(G_n^+)$ and $M(G_n^+)^*$ minors forcing a $U_{k,2k}$-minor did not turn up a resolution; related structural results on bicircular matroids and excluded minors exist but do not address this conjecture. It appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: On the interplay between graphs and matroids (Oxley)
status_evidence.snippet: Discussion of bicircular matroids, grid graphs, and conjectures regarding minors involving uniform matroids U_{k,2k}.
status_evidence.claim: Related conjectures involving forcing U_{k,2k}-minors via highly interconnected matroid minors are stated as open.

status_evidence.title: The limits of structure theory? | The Matroid Union
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses open structural conjectures around excluding uniform matroids and bicircular/graphic matroids.
status_evidence.claim: Conjectures of this flavor remain unresolved in the literature.
